get_ddl.REPORTING.VW_ACCOUNT_FACILITY:
create or replace view VW_ACCOUNT_FACILITY(
	ACCOUNT_ID,
	REGISTRATION_NUMBER,
	ORGANIZATION_NAME,
	CITY,
	PROVINCE,
	CONTACT_NAME,
	CONTACT_PHONE,
	CONTACT_EMAIL,
	LICENCE_NUMBER,
	PRODUCER_ROLE,
	BREEDER_ROLE,
	HATCHERY_ROLE,
	GRADER_ROLE,
	ACCOUNT_STATUS,
	FACILITY_ID,
	FACILITY_NAME,
	FACILITY_TYPE,
	FACILITY_STATUS,
	ACTIVATION_DATE,
	CLOSURE_DATE
) as
SELECT
    a.ACCOUNT_ID,
    a.REGISTRATION_NUMBER,
    a.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    a.CITY,
    a.PROVINCE,
    a.CONTACT_NAME,
    a.CONTACT_PHONE,
    a.CONTACT_EMAIL,
    a.LICENCE_NUMBER,
    a.PRODUCER_ROLE,
    a.BREEDER_ROLE,
    a.HATCHERY_ROLE,
    a.GRADER_ROLE,
    a.STATUS          AS ACCOUNT_STATUS,
    f.FACILITY_ID,
    f.FACILITY_NAME,
    f.FACILITY_TYPE,
    f.STATUS          AS FACILITY_STATUS,
    f.ACTIVATION_DATE,
    f.CLOSURE_DATE
FROM EFNS_DEV.CORE.ACCOUNT a
LEFT JOIN EFNS_DEV.CORE.FACILITY f ON a.ACCOUNT_ID = f.ACCOUNT_ID;
get_ddl.REPORTING.VW_FLOCK_DETAIL:
create or replace view VW_FLOCK_DETAIL(
	FLOCK_ID,
	FLOCK_NUMBER,
	PERMIT_NUMBER,
	PERMIT_DATE,
	BIRD_COUNT,
	PLACEMENT_DATE,
	HATCH_DATE,
	EGG_COLOUR,
	EST_DISPOSAL,
	DISPOSAL_DATE,
	DISPOSAL_METHOD,
	FLOCK_STATUS,
	ACCOUNT_ID,
	REGISTRATION_NUMBER,
	ORGANIZATION_NAME,
	FACILITY_ID,
	FACILITY_NAME,
	FACILITY_TYPE,
	FLOCK_ACCOUNT_ID,
	FLOCK_ACCOUNT_NAME,
	FACILITY_ACCOUNT_ID,
	FACILITY_ACCOUNT_NAME
) as
SELECT
    fl.FLOCK_ID,
    fl.FLOCK_NUMBER,
    fl.PERMIT_NUMBER,
    fl.PERMIT_DATE,
    fl.BIRD_COUNT,
    fl.PLACEMENT_DATE,
    fl.HATCH_DATE,
    fl.EGG_COLOUR,
    fl.EST_DISPOSAL,
    fl.DISPOSAL_DATE,
    fl.DISPOSAL_METHOD,
    fl.STATUS                AS FLOCK_STATUS,
    fl.ACCOUNT_ID,
    a.REGISTRATION_NUMBER,
    a.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    fl.FACILITY_ID,
    f.FACILITY_NAME,
    f.FACILITY_TYPE,
    fl.ACCOUNT_ID            AS FLOCK_ACCOUNT_ID,
    a.ORGANIZATION_NAME      AS FLOCK_ACCOUNT_NAME,
    f.ACCOUNT_ID             AS FACILITY_ACCOUNT_ID,
    fa.ORGANIZATION_NAME     AS FACILITY_ACCOUNT_NAME
FROM EFNS_DEV.CORE.FLOCK fl
LEFT JOIN EFNS_DEV.CORE.ACCOUNT a ON fl.ACCOUNT_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID
LEFT JOIN EFNS_DEV.CORE.FACILITY f ON fl.FACILITY_ID = f.FACILITY_ID
LEFT JOIN EFNS_DEV.CORE.ACCOUNT fa ON f.ACCOUNT_ID = fa.ACCOUNT_ID;
